annotations.title: Look up consultation and service prices

description: Use this when someone asks what their medical practice charges for a consultation, check-up, vaccination or other service. Returns catalog service names with price and last edit time, alphabetically, 50 per page by default. Not for a patient's medical history or the care they received.

clinicId.description: Only this practice (24 lowercase hexadecimal characters); every practice when absent

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page with the same filters; absent for the first page

limit.description: Services per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 50

name: list_procedures

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

procedures.description: Service catalog entries in name order. Patient-linked treatments, diagnoses, prescriptions and record identifiers are never returned.

duration.description: Configured duration, or null when none was recorded

title: Look up consultation and service prices
